fx.weapon_slash.style: hard edge sword arc, blue-white core, yellow hot pixels
fx.weapon_slash.defaultAnchor: between hero and enemy, above weapon contact line

fx.hit_spark.style: yellow-orange cross spark with red pixel debris

fx.heavy_impact.role: heavy hit or guard break shock
fx.heavy_impact.style: diamond shock contour, horizontal pixel shock line, debris chunks
fx.heavy_impact.defaultAnchor: target torso or guard break point

fx.inner_guard.style: broken jade ring with four cardinal pixel marks
fx.inner_guard.defaultAnchor: actor chest center, never over UI

fx.shaolin_gold_body.style: gold diamond shield, vertical and horizontal bronze axis pixels

fx.taiji_spiral.style: black-white rotating broken arcs with jade accent pixels

fx.six_meridian_sword.style: six narrow cyan, blue, and gold pixel beams
fx.six_meridian_sword.defaultAnchor: line from caster hand toward target torso

fx.ancient_tomb_moon.style: cold crescent arc with blue shadow and icy trailing pixels

fx.romance_assist.style: paired rose and gold silhouettes with hand-link pixels
fx.romance_assist.defaultAnchor: beside hero, leaving room for future partner sprite

acceptance: FX are separate from actor body and weapon sprites.
FX use hard pixel edges and nearest filtering.
FX avoid full-screen soft circles and UI-like labels.
FX can be previewed with WUXIA_GODOT_PREVIEW_FX.
Theme FX expose their source system through category and theme metadata.
